notes: CoreWeave release: contract value "up to $6.5 billion"; recaps the March 2025 initial agreement of up to $11.9 billion and the May 2025 expansion of up to $4 billion, and states the new deal "brings the total contract value with OpenAI up to approximately $22.4 billion".

title: Exclusive: CoreWeave expands OpenAI pact with new $6.5 billion contract
notes: Reuters exclusive: third major expansion of the partnership this year after the March $11.9B initial deal and the May $4B add-on, taking total agreements to up to $22.4 billion.

title: CoreWeave signs new $4 bln deal with OpenAI, filing shows
notes: Reuters: additional agreement under which OpenAI committed to pay CoreWeave up to $4 billion through April 2029, shown in a regulatory filing; CoreWeave had flagged a $4B expansion with an unnamed AI enterprise on its post-earnings call.

title: Expanding our use of Google Cloud TPUs and Services
notes: Anthropic announcement: plans to expand use of Google Cloud technologies "including up to one million TPUs"; "the expansion is worth tens of billions of dollars and is expected to bring well over a gigawatt of capacity online in 2026."

title: Anthropic to Expand Use of Google Cloud TPUs and Services
notes: Google Cloud release: Anthropic "will train and serve Claude models with plans to access up to 1 million TPUs, worth tens of billions of dollars," the largest expansion of Anthropic’s TPU usage to date, with well over a gigawatt of capacity coming online in 2026.

title: Oracle eyes $20 billion AI cloud computing deal with Meta, source says
notes: Reuters (citing Bloomberg, which first reported): Oracle in talks with Meta for a multi-year cloud computing deal worth about $20 billion for training and deploying AI models, in addition to Meta’s existing cloud providers; Meta declined to comment and Oracle did not immediately respond.

title: Oracle stock rises as company confirms Meta cloud deal
notes: Oracle CEO Clay Magouyrk on the record: in 30 days of the current quarter Oracle contracted $65 billion of new cloud infrastructure commitments "across seven different contracts from four different customers. None of those customers are OpenAI" — and Meta is one of the four customers. CNBC notes Bloomberg reported the two were discussing a $20 billion deal in September.
